# Characters extension to Toen's Medieval Strategy Sprite Pack

Author: Exewin. Original art/collaborator: Toen (Andre Mari Coppola).

Official source: https://opengameart.org/content/characters-extension-to-toens-medieval-strategy-sprite-pack

Original archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/characters_3.zip

License selected by the publisher: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

The source specifies use with Toen's original Medieval Strategy Sprite Pack;
this application includes and uses that pack under its bundled CC BY 4.0 grant.

Only `hermit.png` and `uran.png` are included, byte-for-byte from the archive.
They are 16 by 16 pixels. In-game display enlarges and clips the image, arranges
it in troop formations, mirrors enemies, dims spent units, and animates its
position. The original PNG files have not been recolored or otherwise edited.

Copyright remains with the original authors. Credits, the source URL, license
link and the presentation changes must remain with redistributions.
